female.sp: Original NRX-0015 Gundam Ashtaron from After War Gundam X, not Hermit Crab. The attached official reference controls the armor palette and mechanical design: muted gray-lavender armor, dark navy sections, red central chest and hip accents, yellow vents and V-fin, compact rounded polygonal shoulder plates, and the large paired backpack-mounted Atomic Scissors assemblies with their long armored shells and mechanical pincers. Retain both Atomic Scissors as external mechanical equipment clearly separate from her TWO normal human arms and hands. Fold the long assemblies close beside and behind the body so their complete silhouette fits a tight vertical composition. No scorpion tail or biological pincers; scorpion is only a cool dangerous personality cue. Sexy adult wearable armor with fitted breast plates and a secure deep neckline, bare side waist and abdomen gaps, opaque high-cut pelvic coverage, short split hip armor and exposed upper thighs. Shoulder armor remains attached and recognizable. Normal human upper arms, elbows, forearms, wrists, five-fingered hands, thighs, knees, calves and ankles; human-foot-shaped boots with source armor layered over them, no robot stilts, no extra biological limbs. Deep dark teal sharply cut chin-length bob, pale lavender eyes, cool poised adult Korean face, straight lips and horizontally long eyes. No resemblance to the pilot. Composition override: frame the adult character LARGE, almost filling the vertical image like the user-preferred tight Virsago portrait. Minimal headroom and minimal floor margin; do not shrink the figure to create generous empty borders. All important body parts remain readable, but a V-fin close to the top edge is acceptable. Do not change the generator default background. No invented handheld gun, text, watermark, literal scorpion anatomy or duplicate weapons.
